prompt: This JPEG-like carver accepts `ff d8 ff d9` as a complete 4-byte image. Tap the faulty line.
explain: The footer search must start after the three header bytes (`j = i + 3`). Starting at `i + 2` lets the last byte of the header act as the first byte of `ff d9`, so a header followed directly by `d9` looks like a complete object.
